title: Last Day In Florida
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight is promoted to VP of Sabre Retail and remains in Florida permanently, marking a significant change for the office. The staff debates the contents of Dwight's 'treasure box,' which Creed opens to reveal a photo and a dart. Meanwhile, Erin reveals she will not return to the office as she works as a live-in helper for an elderly woman named Irene. Jim warns Dwight about Robert California's plan to sabotage the Sabre store presentation and potentially fire Dwight, but Dwight dismisses the warning. The episode also features competitive moments between Darryl and Toby over cookie sales, and Todd Packer's brief appointment and subsequent firing as vice president of Sabre Retail. The episode ends with Andy preparing to go to Florida to bring Erin back, while Dwight and Jim return to the office to a warm welcome.
